comment: Default blocked-words list for chat moderation. Override at runtime by setting CHAT_BLOCKED_WORDS_FILE to a path with the same JSON shape. The matcher is whole-word, case-insensitive, and applied to a normalized message where common obfuscations (1->i, 3->e, 0->o, 5->s, 7->t, @->a, $->s) are folded back to letters. Keep entries lowercase, single tokens or short phrases.
